notes: The semantic replay uses the MCP/CLI two-storey fixture as the deterministic payload source.
Cmd+K entries are validated as registered UI bridge surfaces with capability metadata.
Activator, navigation, dialog, and local UI entries remain blockers and are excluded from deterministic Cmd+K commit counts.
Stair, slab opening, and stair railing are validated only through raw fixture replay until typed vertical-circulation tools exist.

rows.blocker: Project setup opens level UI state but does not expose deterministic createLevel payloads for the 0mm and 3200mm storeys.
Wall type setup is available only through project/type UI state, not a typed Cmd+K semantic commit.
Floor type setup is available only through project/type UI state, not a typed Cmd+K semantic commit.
Roof type setup is available only through project/type UI state, not a typed Cmd+K semantic commit.
Door and window family type setup is not encoded as exact Cmd+K payload input.
The floor command activates sketch mode; the exact ground and upper 12000mm by 9000mm slab boundaries remain gesture state.
Exterior walls can be generated from selected floor boundaries, but upper/lower level assignment and interior partitions still depend on exact fixture payloads or gestures.
Cmd+K activates stair placement; it does not submit base/top levels, run coordinates, width, riser, tread, and shape from the fixture.
Cmd+K activates shaft sketching; it does not submit the fixed upper-floor stair opening boundary.
Cmd+K activates railing placement; it does not submit the hosted stair id and explicit path.
The command commits a default selected-wall door; fixture-specific ids, wall ids, along-wall positions, widths, and family type ids are not supplied by Cmd+K.
The command commits a default selected-wall window; fixture-specific ids, wall ids, along-wall positions, dimensions, sill heights, and family type ids are not supplied by Cmd+K.
The room command activates placement; exact two-level polygons, names, programme codes, and target areas remain gesture or inspector state.
The command derives a roof from selected walls, but the current UI default uses derived parameters rather than the fixture's exact gable roof id, overhang, slope, level, and type payload.
The section command opens or creates section UI through a host callback without the exact stair section line and crop payload.
The 3D view command calls a host callback and is classified as navigation, not a deterministic saveViewpoint command with camera coordinates.
The schedule command opens or creates schedule UI through a host callback without the exact vertical-circulation schedule definition.
The sheet command opens or creates a sheet through a host callback without the exact A201 size, number, name, and metadata payload.
Recommended and section placement can commit viewports, but no static Cmd+K entry encodes the exact A201 ground plan, upper plan, and stair section viewport layout.
The command can tag all rooms, but it does not expose the fixture's single explicit tag id, host view id, position, and text override.
Auto-dimensioning commits derived dimensions, but the fixture uses two explicit overall dimension payloads.

remainingUiBlockers: No browser harness enters exact numeric two-storey slab, wall, stair, shaft, railing, room, opening, roof, sheet, schedule, tag, dimension, and camera payloads and then authors the model through UI state.
Activator-only entries are still blockers for exact floor, wall, stair, shaft, railing, and room geometry: tool.floor-sketch, tool.wall, tool.stair, tool.shaft, tool.railing, and tool.room.
Project/type setup lacks deterministic Cmd+K payloads for createLevel, wall types, floor type, roof type, and family types.
View, schedule, section, and sheet creation use host navigation callbacks rather than typed saveViewpoint, create_schedule_view, createSectionCut, and CreateSheet commits.
Hosted opening, roof, sheet placement, tag, and dimension commands commit defaults or derived payloads; they do not encode the benchmark's exact ids, dimensions, positions, and layout.
Stair, slab opening, and railing remain raw fixture replay only until typed vertical-circulation authoring surfaces are available.
